claim: An Arabic-Indic digit run in an RTL context is returned reversed by MuPDF, including on a file MuPDF itself wrote. Measured on the pinned version; the reversal is the reader's, not the file's, because PDFium reads the same file's run correctly.
control_evidence: python3 -m conformance.readers.controls.mupdf_digits → writes the file with PyMuPDF itself (insert_text, Amiri), reads it back with MuPDF and with PDFium: MuPDF ٦٢٠٢ · PDFium ٢٠٢٦ · reproduces=true
narrowing: Excuses ONLY a truth digit run whose exact reverse is present in the output, and only for MuPDF. A run that is neither present nor reversed stays a defect. The other metrics are untouched.

claim: pdftotext wraps every RTL line in U+202A/U+202B … U+202C embedding marks. They are the extractor's own decorations, not characters the file carries: the same file read by PDFium has none.
control_evidence: python3 -m conformance.readers.controls.poppler_bidi → a Chrome-raw file (the engine's own output, not this pipeline's) with one Arabic paragraph: pdftotext returns 5 bidi controls, PDFium 0, reproduces=true
narrowing: Excuses bidi controls in pdftotext's output only, and only up to the number the control shows it adds per line. Presentation Forms, PUA, U+FFFD and tatweel excess stay counted.
